title: AIR CONDITIONING-CARB SOLENOID WIRING
summary: Air conditioning (C60) wiring between the A/C compressor feed wire and the carburetor idle solenoid, for cars with RPO LJ1-LJ2 and M20-M21 transmissions. This sheet was CANCELED 10-24-69. As drawn, the compressor feed wire's connector is removed, the wire is inserted into a connector [2] and plugged into the jumper of harness [1], which runs over the engine to the solenoid assembly.

fastening.note: View A: the compressor feed wire's own connector is removed; the wire goes into connector [2], which plugs into the jumper of [1]. [1] runs across the top of the engine to the carburetor solenoid assembly. No mechanical fasteners shown.

notes: NOTE: Remove connector from compressor feed wire. Insert wire into [2] & plug it into jumper of [1].
notes_internal: Sheet CANCELED (stamp and revision 1); no callout list printed, so items [1] (wire/jumper harness) and [2] (connector) have no part numbers and are left out of parts.
Model box prints 'RPO LJ1-LJ2' as read; copied as printed.
Revision 1 date last digit partly smudged; reads 10-24-69.
